claims.claim: Generated observation variation improves held-out compositional history retrieval.
claims.boundary: Same simulator and mechanisms; three independent training collections, shared 96 test worlds.

claims.claim: Observation variation improves reserved loan history F1 over the paired original-observation learner.
claims.boundary: All three loan pairs are complete; improvement is modest and identity recall remains low.

claims.claim: The method is dependable under arbitrary logging-pipeline changes.
claims.boundary: Loan pipeline history F1 worsens in all three trials.

claims.claim: Generated supervision removes the need for any target-specific assessment.
claims.boundary: False merges and damage to initially correct records remain; generated calibration is not a new-domain safety guarantee.

claims.claim: The work introduces graph-based identifier repair, simulation or domain randomization.
claims.boundary: Relevant established prior work is cited; contribution concerns paired executable supervision and measured history-repair behavior.

claims.claim: The system is a new temporal GNN or deep generative model.
claims.boundary: The principal edit scorer is a histogram boosting classifier; neural edit models are controls.

claims.claim: The method outperforms published native-task methods under their original protocols.
claims.boundary: No exact HERE/SANAGRAPH/EKG numerical reproduction. Information assumptions differ; adaptations are explicitly labeled.

claims.claim: The test measures recovery of independently labeled natural errors.
claims.boundary: Controlled recording faults use released public references or symbolic simulated truth.

claims.claim: The general scientific dataset factory is complete.
claims.boundary: Only bounded executable-world/task interfaces are implemented for this paper.

claims.claim: The relocated review artifact can reproduce fixed model decisions.
claims.boundary: Same interpreter/environment: all six models replayed on the fixed first generated graph, all 14 tasks regenerated, and a complete mixed task reproduced byte-identical outputs. Raw public BPI2012 also regenerates its exact check split. No new-hardware retraining claim.

claims.claim: All declared confirmation experiments have finished.
claims.boundary: All 84 original selected real-source jobs, six generated-model runs and nine separately declared follow-up runs completed. Four reserved simulations (112 planned jobs) remain unexecuted after documented download failures.

claims.claim: Varied observations improve reserved purchasing history F1 over the paired original learner.
claims.boundary: Three complete pairs: mean .826342 versus .809140; false identity pairs 37/12/5 and newly damaged events 145/179/54 remain.

claims.claim: The selected boosted learner uniformly outperforms neural edit models.
claims.boundary: GraphSAGE has higher loan trial-zero F1 (.812206 versus .807628), alongside more newly damaged events (1848 versus 295). Report the trade-off without post-hoc utility selection.

claims.claim: The source model’s poor original loan transfer is intrinsic to its fitted weights.
claims.boundary: An explicitly post-freeze switch to an already-frozen generated calibration raises F1 from .547178 to .792180 without changing the source weights.

claims.claim: Paired observation variation improves the held-out BPI2012 check relative to original-observation training.
claims.boundary: All three pairs positive; mean .815459 versus .776036. Source supervision and some neural/stable-field configurations remain stronger.

claims.claim: Every historical source-archive byte checksum field was recorded correctly.
claims.boundary: Eight transient byte-checksum fields are preserved with explicit errata. Every member of all 60 archives matches its recorded source inventory. Scientific model/data pins are unaffected.
